environment.description: Container running on Kubernetes with default security context (no MAC enforcement). The container runs as uid 1000 with read access to host-mounted /etc/shadow via a misconfigured hostPath volume. No AppArmor or SELinux profile applied (annotation: container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/logstreamer: unconfined). The process has CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH capability retained.
